description: Two HD participants exchange the eight pinned VCTK clips through the chappe demo (demo/sbc, make demo): a G.722 talker at 16 kHz and an Opus listener at 48 kHz, and the reverse. Baseline: room 1004, mod_conference on its 16 kHz wideband profile, run twice. Candidate: room 1003, chappe_mix at 16 kHz in L16 behind rtpengine 26.3.1.4. The pcmu-join conditions hold one run per arm and direction during which a silent PCMU caller joins and leaves the room.

margins.declared_by: chappe integration (HD conferences and conference REFER, phase 1), before any capture
margins.note: Declared before any capture of either arm. Scorers: the candidate passes when the lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval of the paired difference (candidate minus baseline, per clip) stays above -0.3 MOS, for ViSQOL and for NISQA. 0.3 sits below the 0.38 NISQA drop the tool measured between a G.722 and a PCMU path, so a narrowband hop fails it, and above the shifts two runs of one path are expected to show. Bandwidth: every candidate capture keeps its 4-7 kHz share within 6 dB of the reference; a hop through 8 kHz reads 33 to 53 dB down. Level within 6 dB, no clipping beyond 1e-4 of the samples, no gap in active speech longer than 40 ms (two 20 ms packets). Delay is not gated: taq live has no synchronized timestamps. The pcmu-join conditions have one clip per arm, so their scorers are reported and not gated; their bandwidth, level, clipping and dropout checks are gated as everywhere.
